//installCommand: The web app imports `@classconnect/shared`, which is a workspace package. Installing from the repo root rather than from `apps/web` is what makes that resolvable; `outputFileTracingRoot` in next.config.mjs then carries it into the deployed function.
//buildCommand: The shared package is TypeScript and must be compiled before Next can consume its type declarations.
buildCommand: npm run build --workspace @classconnect/shared && npm run build
